name: bluechip Engine and database
description: [bluechip] Workflows, the engine backlog, the desk, crons, the outbox and the database.

query.mpl:
`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.engine.workflow.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket by `workflow` to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.5, 0.95)

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.engine.workflow.retries`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `workflow` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.engine.backlog`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using max
| group by `entity` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.desk.queue`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using max
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.cron.runs`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.cron.lag`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket by `cron` to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.95)

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.outbox.pending`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using max
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.outbox.age`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using max
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`db.client.operation.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| bucket by `db.table` to $__interval using interpolate_delta_histogram(0.95)

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`db.client.transaction.duration`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| where `axiom.histogram` == "count"
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`db.client.connections`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using max
| group by `state` using sum

charts.name: Queries that dominate time (kept statement spans)

query.apl:
declare query_parameters (env:string = "production");
['${TRACES_DATASET}']
| where tostring(column_ifexists('resource.deployment.environment', '')) == env
| extend span = tostring(column_ifexists('name', '')), ms = todouble(column_ifexists('duration', 0)) / 1000000
| where span startswith 'select ' or span startswith 'insert ' or span startswith 'update ' or span startswith 'delete '
| summarize total_ms = sum(ms), p95_ms = percentile(ms, 95), n = count() by span
| order by total_ms desc
| take 20
